__doc: Competitive regions. `lobbyModifier` is added to every tournament lobby rating in that region (EU is the hardest region in the game). `reputationMultiplier` scales the reputation you earn there, so winning in EU is worth far more than winning in OCE. `talentModifier` shifts the average quality of players generated from that region.

regions.name: Europe
regions.blurb: The deepest and most brutal region. Everything is contested, nothing is free.

regions.name: NA Central
regions.blurb: Loud, mechanical and stacked at the top. Second only to EU.

regions.name: NA West
regions.blurb: Thin at the top but a real region. Good place to farm early points.

regions.name: Brazil
regions.blurb: Fearless drop-and-fight culture. Aggro archetypes are everywhere.

regions.name: Asia
regions.blurb: Small competitive scene, but the mechanics ceiling is real.

regions.name: Oceania
regions.blurb: The easiest lobbies in the world. Great for prize money, terrible for respect.

regions.name: Middle East
regions.blurb: Ping-cursed and underrated. Quietly produces monsters.
